findings.description: The source planner digested exact Git blobs, but the CocoIndex adapter reread mutable worktree content. A transient edit could be embedded and restored before the final source proof.
findings.resolution: Pass each planned Git-blob digest into the memoized file function, hash the final byte read, and decode those same verified bytes without reopening the file.

findings.description: Storage verification happened before the publication transaction, leaving a mutation window before table rename and manifest publication.
findings.resolution: Repeat decisive manifest/count/schema/HNSW verification under an access-exclusive attempt-table lock, advisory lock, unexpired lease, and the same transaction used for rename and manifest publication.

findings.description: The parent compatibility trigger guarded UPDATE only, so a direct INSERT with parent_index_id could bypass ready, compatibility, and non-legacy checks.
findings.resolution: Add a BEFORE INSERT parent guard, lock the selected parent FOR SHARE, and test compatible, incompatible, and legacy direct inserts.

findings.description: A configured but unreachable registry was returned as not_configured even though only an absent DSN has that outcome.
findings.resolution: Return an ephemeral failed result with registry_unavailable for pool/connect failures while preserving missing_database as not_configured.

findings.description: Garbage collection could select an expired ready index still referenced as an incremental parent, causing the parent-target trigger to abort the run.
findings.resolution: Exclude referenced parents in both candidate selection and the atomic claim statement; descendants are collected before ancestors.

findings.description: The custom CocoIndex embedder wrapper had no explicit stable memo key or vector-schema provider, so embedding-contract invalidation and App schema construction were not proven.
findings.resolution: Implement a canonical memo key over provider fingerprint, dimension, and indexing parameters; implement the pinned public VectorSchemaProvider contract and return float32 vectors.
